nodes.label: Adversarial In-Distribution Reviewer (odd-one-out)
nodes.rationale: Guesses which of N anonymised essays is AI-assisted from voice, argument architecture, citation integration, vocabulary tier, and LLM tells; guess_confidence 0.5 means chance, and a null guess at 0.0 confidence is a strong pass. Pass threshold: confidence below 0.5 or a wrong guess.
